summary: Verified the Checkout minimum-order bug fix end-to-end (backend + frontend) for MARTbakēd. Backend rule now correctly compares TOTAL PAYABLE (subtotal + delivery_fee) against min_order instead of subtotal alone. All 10 pytest cases pass — including the exact screenshot scenario (subtotal 2600 XOF → total 3100 XOF ≥ 3000) which now succeeds, plus the boundary cases 2900/3000/3700. Frontend visual gating verified on Mobile Cart (m-cart-min-order-warning + disabled m-cart-checkout), Mobile Checkout when reached via natural nav (m-co-pay + eligibility), Desktop Cart (cart-min-order-warning + cart-checkout-btn disabled), Desktop Checkout (checkout-min-order-warning + checkout-place-order-btn disabled). Banner disappears and checkout enables as soon as cart is raised over the threshold — confirmed with UI reload after API cart edit. Two blocking bugs were found and fixed in-scope: (a) CheckoutPage.jsx contained stray `e>` + duplicate closing tags at lines 189-192 causing a Babel SyntaxError and the entire frontend to not compile; (b) GET /api/carts/me returned HTTP 500 for brand-new customers because Mongo's ObjectId `_id` leaked out of `_cart_for()` (insert_one mutates the passed dict). Both were repaired and validated.

minor.issue: Was returning 500 (ObjectId not iterable) for any customer whose active cart did not yet exist. Root cause: db.carts.insert_one(doc) mutated doc with ObjectId _id, which then hit FastAPI's serializer. FIXED by adding doc.pop('_id', None) after insert_one in /app/backend/modules/mart/routes.py::_cart_for().

ui_bugs.issue: Stray 'e>' and duplicate closing tags at lines 189-192 caused SyntaxError: Unexpected token — the entire frontend refused to compile (users saw the red 'Compiled with problems' overlay). FIXED by deleting the orphan block.

integration_issues.flow: Direct navigation to /checkout on mobile with under-min cart
integration_issues.issue: MobileCheckout.jsx has useEffect(() => { if(!cart.items?.length) nav('/cart') }) which fires before the cart context has hydrated from /api/carts/me on a fresh page load. Effect: hitting /checkout via URL/bookmark/hard reload always redirects to /cart, so the m-co-min-order-warning and disabled m-co-pay Add-more state are unreachable via that path. Not blocking the bug fix because the user flow is Cart → click Checkout btn (only when eligible, since the btn is disabled otherwise). RECOMMEND: guard with a loading flag from useCart, e.g. if (cart.loading) return null; only redirect after cart is hydrated.

action_items: MAIN AGENT: Fix MobileCheckout redirect-on-mount race — replace the empty-cart useEffect with a guard that waits for the cart context to finish loading (e.g. `if (!cart.loaded) return <Spinner/>` or check a boolean set once GET /api/carts/me resolves). This will make direct /checkout navigation surface the under-min warning + 'Add more' state instead of redirecting to /cart.
MAIN AGENT: Consider adding a regression test for the CheckoutPage.jsx compile error (e.g. `yarn build` in CI or a smoke test that visits /checkout in desktop viewport).
critical_code_review_comments: cart_rules.py is a clean, well-documented Single-Source-of-Truth. Rounding to 2 decimals before comparison correctly avoids float artefacts. Mirror in /app/frontend/src/lib/checkout.js uses the same math.
orders.py::create_order now uses check_order_eligibility for both the 400 gate AND the persisted totals — subtotal, delivery_fee, and total all come from the same eligibility object. Good.
GET /mart/cart/eligibility is the correct endpoint to expose to the frontend if you want to eliminate client-side drift entirely, but the current mirror module in JS is sufficient for the check.
MobileCart & MobileCheckout removed the previously-hidden 200-XOF packing fee — visible total now matches the backend computed total, resolving the confusion in the original screenshot.
IMPROVEMENT: MobileCheckout should render nothing (or a skeleton) until the cart is confirmed hydrated — the useEffect empty-cart redirect fires prematurely on cold navigation.
IMPROVEMENT: `_cart_for()` in routes.py should `.pop('_id', None)` right after insert_one — the pattern is fragile. Same defensive pattern is already used in _find_or_create_customer_by_phone.
MINOR: CheckoutPage.jsx build error implies no lint/CI gate on frontend. Recommend adding `yarn build --check` to a pre-merge hook.

It uses live seeded product IDs (Banane Cavendish=prd_951e138789dd4128 @800, Chips Classic=prd_0c1550b414244953 @500, Coca=prd_b01b51d4dbed4c34 @900, Baguette=prd_5a66ea776e1948a1 @400) — if seed prices change, update the price constants. rca_of_the_issue: Original min-order bug: /app/backend/modules/mart/orders.py used `if subtotal < min_order` — this compared PRODUCT SUBTOTAL only, ignoring the 500 XOF delivery fee. So a subtotal of 2600 (with delivery 500 → total 3100) was blocked because 2600 < 3000, even though the user's payable total (3100) exceeded the 3000 threshold. Root cause: rule was applied to the wrong number. Fix: centralized check_order_eligibility(subtotal, delivery_fee, free_delivery_over, min_order) computes total = subtotal + delivery_fee (respecting free_delivery_over cutoff) then compares total >= min_order. Frontend mirror (checkout.js) uses identical math for the UI gate. Both surfaces now match the visible 'Total' line.
